Name: 787 Coffee
Description: Good amount of outlets and community vibes, chill space to get work done

Name: Kofee
Description: Koffee (Brooklyn) is an amazing local small business featuring strong, tasty drinks and great food in a work-friendly atmosphere. It offers a cozy, highly welcoming environment with varied seating, including front booth options. The Brooklyn location charms with its intimate setup, while its sister spot in the Bronx offers even more room to settle in.

Name: The Clubhouse Cafe
Description: The Clubhouse Cafe is a family-friendly spot that features beautiful decor, relaxed vibes, and full-bodied coffee paired with pastries from Mottley Kitchen. It offers a quiet, safe environment to focus on work or catch up with friends while watching sports or listening to chill music. All proceeds directly support youth programs through the South Bronx United nonprofit.

Name: Mottley Kitchen
Description: Mottley Kitchen is a cozy local cafe and restaurant located in the South Bronx featuring exposed white brick and warm wooden accents. It serves a delicious variety of coffee, pastries, and healthy breakfast and lunch options including vegetarian and vegan choices. It also boasts a wonderful outdoor rooftop space with neighborhood views.

Name: Prince Coffee House
Description: Avenue Coffee House features a unique layout with a window-front view that transitions into a cement-based back area, accented by wood seating and background music for a cozy vibe. Flooded with tons of natural sunlight, it offers both wall and hand-held menus to browse. It is a fantastic destination known for its great coffee drinks and impressive food menu.

Name: KYAN Cafe
Description: WiFi (ask for it), fair amount of seating but crowded but no outlet or restroom

Name: Artizen Cafe
Description: Artizen Cafe combines creative energy with a comfortable workspace environment, making it a favorite for local freelancers and remote workers. The interior features artistic touches and plenty of cozy spots to settle in with a laptop. Alongside smooth specialty coffee, they offer a rotating selection of fresh pastries and light bites.

Name: Mon Amour Coffee & Wine
Description: Mon Amour Cafe is a hidden gem in the upper Bronx with a welcoming community and space, cozy but homey with great food, drinks and hospitality. Happy hour later in the evening, great for productive work days and an unwinding after all in the same spot.

Name: Savor Coffee and More
Description: Savor Coffee and More is a welcoming neighborhood haven known for its comforting atmosphere and reliable productivity space. It features a great selection of classic coffee drinks, teas, and delicious baked goods to fuel a long work session. The friendly service and cozy seating make it a go-to local spot for getting things done.
RestrictionAmount: Only permitted to stay with purchase

Name: Nefer Bookcafe
Description: Nefer Bookcafe is a peaceful and unique cultural sanctuary that blends the love of literature with a cozy coffeehouse experience. Surrounded by curated bookshelves, it provides a quiet atmosphere ideal for reading, focused work, or intimate conversation. It offers a warm selection of hot drinks and light bites in a uniquely intellectual setting.

Name: The Way Cafe
Description: Great cafe with coffee, different drinks other than coffee and hot food

Name: The Boogie Down Grind
Description: The Boogie Down Grind is a hip-hop culture-themed oasis in the South Bronx that brings the community together through art, music, and great drinks. Locally owned and operated, it serves a fantastic mix of espresso drinks, baked goods, and savory sandwiches. It also features award-winning outdoor seating alongside its vibrant indoor lounge space.

Name: Fontainhas
Description: Sweet and welcoming employees, kind about laptops restrictions must be at the bar especially when it gets busy, interesting backstory, emphasises connection with each other as humans, stays open late until 10/10:30, great food and coffee

Name: Swallow Cafe
Description: Swallow Cafe is a cozy cafe with a small upstairs area overlooking the cafe inside, hidden gem in Brooklyn known for it's often quiet atmosphere, more social on the weekends but overall a great place to visit with a rustic aesthetic to get work done, good food and wifi, note laptop designated areas.

Name: Brooklyn Kolache Co
Description: Brooklyn Kolache brings a unique twist to the local cafe scene by pairing specialty coffee with traditional, freshly baked sweet and savory Czech kolaches. The warm, inviting space features cozy seating areas that are great for settling in with a laptop or a book. It offers a deliciously distinct flavor experience alongside a friendly neighborhood ambiance.

Name: High & Dry Coffee Bar
Description: High & Dry Coffee Bar is a sleek, no-fuss destination centered entirely around top-tier brewing craftsmanship. The minimalist aesthetic keeps distractions low, making it a peaceful environment to lock in and get deep work done. Known for its expertly crafted espresso and clean layout, it's a hidden gem for productivity purists.
RestrictionAmount: As long as purchases continue every few hours.

Name: The Concrete Jungle
Description: The Concrete Jungle embraces its iconic city namesake with an urban-chic interior and an energetic neighborhood vibe. It serves up robust coffee selections and satisfying bites in a space designed for modern creatives and remote professionals. The lively environment provides a great backdrop for hustle and socialization alike.

Name: BKLYN BLEND
Description: Described to be cozy and inviting, community oriented, known to be a cozy space but has great holistic food/drink options and everything you'd need to get work done, hidden gem for a quick hideaway, not too much walking room but more of a cozier smaller vibe.

Name: Covert BK
Description: Covert BK features a friendly, bubbly community with high energy and good vibes for productivity, alongside its fair share of quieter days as a true hidden gem. It is a fantastic neighborhood spot that is particularly well-known for its exceptionally delicious pork, egg, and cheese sandwich, which makes the trip entirely worth it.

Name: As you like
Description: WPA2-Personal key confirmed, more hidden cozy and lowkey cafe but features awesome ceramics and merch, fun drink options and yummy onigiris/japanese egg sandwich. Primary seating is a big table and two corners for seating, best for getting work done for a short amount of time to avoid overcrowding but great for getting work done when not busy, very calm and friendly vibes. Even hosts workshops you can find more info on, online. Fair amount of outlets throughout seating. Only downfall is no restroom, otherwise fun chill sppace.

Name: Here Bk
Description: Here Bk is a laid-back, modern cafe and bar that features a quiet corner atmosphere, good natural sunlight, and primarily booth seating with window-close outlets. Known for hosting local events and supporting entrepreneurs with community flyers, it offers common pastries and premade sandwiches alongside its own custom merch. It is an ideal spot to transition from a focused workday into a relaxing alcoholic drink to wind down.

Name: Lakou Cafe
Description: Lakou Cafe is a culture-deep Brooklyn spot that blends Haitian heritage with modern vibes, offering smooth coffee, smoothies, and delicious food. Founded by Cassandre Davilmar, it serves as a healthy-minded community space with great seating and outlets that transitions into chill vibes after work hours. It proudly stands as a Black-owned, women-owned, and Latino-owned neighborhood gem.

Name: Postmark Cafe
Description: Postmark Cafe is a beloved, community-driven small business featuring an active community board and a small outdoor box for food donations. It offers both indoor and outdoor seating options alongside basic drinks and pastries, complete with charming pink accents and signature pink lids. With a kid-friendly space, it serves as a warm and welcoming local neighborhood hub.

Name: Kofee
Description: Koffee (Brooklyn) is an amazing local small business featuring strong, tasty drinks and great food in a work-friendly atmosphere. It offers a cozy, highly welcoming environment with varied seating, including front booth options. The Brooklyn location charms with its intimate setup, while its sister spot in the Bronx offers even more room to settle in.

Name: Connecticut Muffin
Description: Supportive of small businesses (hung up flyer and business cards) and artists (displays artwork around the cafe), must buy item to use bathroom and wifi though and wifi is open and unsecured but no password

Name: Victorian Cafe
Description: Victorian Cafe offers a friendly, welcoming environment with additional seating tucked away in the back and a good amount of outlets available. The spot serves great coffee and food, highlighted by unique specialty drinks like their pistachio latte and delicious almond lemon cake. It provides a comfortable, inviting atmosphere for anyone looking to enjoy a tasty treat while getting settled in.

Name: Botani Cafe
Description: Minimalist and clean approach cafe that additionally sellfs merch and coffee beans by Deviocion, tons of natural sunlight but outlets are minimum and scattered.

Name: Cup Of Brooklyn
Description: Cup Of Brooklyn is a cozy, tiny cafe that offers great welcoming vibes and a well-lit, rustic clean wood aesthetic. It features fresh bagels, delicious pastries, and standout drinks like their Nutella latte. It provides a charming and comfortable setting that is ideal for either getting some focused work done or socializing with others.

Name: Sweet Sundays Cafe
Description: Sweet Sundays Cafe captures a relaxed, weekend-morning energy every single day of the week. With bright lighting, cheerful decor, and comfortable seating, it provides an uplifting environment for catching up on tasks. Their menu features comforting specialty lattes and a wonderful assortment of sweet treats.

Name: HEADREST COFFEE
Description: HEADREST COFFEE is a limited but cozy, plant-filled spot with eccentric, welcoming employees and a fun selection of merch, stickers, and coffee accessories. While seating and accessible outlets are limited, it features popular sandwiches and a unique menu that make it well worth a quick stop. It is a fantastic destination for a short productivity session and a tasty bite.

Name: Nook
Description: Nook fosters a strong community vibe with evening events on select days, a productive atmosphere, and big spacious windows that invite plenty of natural sunlight. It features yummy, filling sandwiches alongside board games and a fun social environment that draws a lively crowd. Because of its popularity, it fills up quickly, making it a great spot to arrive early for a productive work session.

Name: TOLK
Description: TOLK is an expansive, open-space venue that doubles as a regularly rotating art gallery, featuring plenty of walking room and a cozy couch. It offers simple pastries alongside standout specialty drinks that blend everyday coffee orders with wellness benefits. With outlets everywhere and complimentary dog treats, it is a uniquely convenient spot for remote work.

Name: Burly Coffee
Description: Burly Coffee is a small, minimalist neighborhood spot with cute basic decor and a relaxed environment that is famously dog-friendly. It serves up tasty breakfast tacos alongside delicious coffee. Visitors can also enjoy a fun touch with their signature cute crossword puzzles.

Name: Paper Coffee
Description: Pay attention to any spaces that might not be laptop friendly but overall is welcomed, no public wifi though but great place to work from home with tons of outlets and seating, beautiful space

Name: Gemina Coffee Shop
Description: Gemina Coffee Shop offers a refined yet cozy environment tailored for both productivity and leisurely catch-ups. The interior is tastefully decorated, providing ample natural light and comfortable nooks to settle in with a project. Their drink menu features expertly balanced specialty lattes and classic favorites.

Name: Telegraphe Cafe
Description: Dedicated space on the side of the cozy cafe dedicated to laptop work with outlets, hot food avaliable but limited space.

Name: Sweet Moment
Description: Sweet Moment is a playful, highly photogenic cafe famous for its whimsical specialty drinks and iconic cream art treats. The bright and cheerful interior creates a lighthearted atmosphere that is wonderful for casual socializing or creative planning. It serves up a uniquely fun experience alongside comforting beverages.

Name: ARVACI Coffee East
Description: ARVACI Coffee is a contemporary neighborhood hotspot featuring sleek aesthetics and a serious dedication to the craft of coffee. The streamlined interior design offers a comfortable setup for individuals looking to plug in and focus. With smooth specialty drinks and a quiet ambiance, it stands out as an exceptional local workspace.

Name: Gold Coffee
Description: Gold Coffee is a sleek and inviting neighborhood spot that delivers high-quality brews in a polished setting. It features a clean, minimalist aesthetic with comfortable seating areas tailored for focused laptop sessions. Friendly baristas and a steady stream of delicious espresso drinks make it a reliable daytime workspace.

Name: The Station Cafe
Description: 90 minutes time limit, has cafe WiFi you can use though but no outlets

Name: Culture Espresso
Description: Culture Espresso is widely considered one of the best in New York and even won a \"Best in North America\" cookie-off, beating out heavyweights like Levain from Upper West Side, very cozy and welcoming cafe with tastry sweet treats worth the commute.

Name: Rex
Description: Rex is a stylish neighborhood staple that blends effortless cool with a deeply welcoming community atmosphere. The space is thoughtfully designed with comfortable seating options that accommodate laptop users and casual conversationalists alike. Paired with stellar espresso and friendly service, it anchors the local cafe scene.

Name: Spitfire Cheese & Sundry
Description: More of a socializing cafe can get busy and noisy quickly but good to get some quick work done unless you dont mind the noise

Name: Caffe Aronne
Description: Cozy place to get work done, clean restrooms, simple and minimalist cafe to get some work done or socialize

Name: Malta Coffee
Description: Great atmosphere with fun drinks and comfy seating

Name: Slate Cafe Midtown
Description: Nice place to get some work done plenty of seating. Good drinks, friendly staff, WiFi, Restroom, but no outlets.

Name: The Monkey Cup
Address: 1965 Adam Clayton Powell Jr Blvd, New York, NY 10026
Description: There is no wifi you will have to hotspot for this cafe but otherwise a great environment to get work doneThe Monkey Cup is a charming and vibrant coffee shop known for its playful branding and welcoming atmosphere. It offers a cozy interior with great seating options that easily accommodate remote workers and casual meetups. Patrons can enjoy deeply flavorful coffee blends paired with a delicious assortment of fresh pastries.

Name: Plowshares Coffee Roasters
Description: a very cozy, community-centered aesthetic that feels like a blend of a modern café, a neighborhood living room, and an artist’s workspace.

Name: The Townhouse Cafe
Description: The Townhouse Cafe offers a uniquely residential, cozy charm that makes visitors feel right at home the moment they step inside. The intimate layout features comfortable seating areas and a relaxed pace that helps melt away workday stress. It is a wonderful hideaway for reading, light administrative work, or a quiet conversation.

Name: Featuring The Cafe
Description: Featuring the cafe is ran by a married couple, very family and community oriented, known for their delicious food and housemade syrups, space is limited but still cozy and welcoming!

Name: NBHD Brulee
Address: 2620 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10030
Description: When you walk in, it doesn’t have that sterile, ultra-modern coffee shop vibe. Instead, it’s warm, nostalgic, and full of personality. The décor leans heavily into Harlem’s history and culture, with vintage touches, artwork, historical photos, and cultural icons throughout the space. The owners intentionally designed it to reflect neighborhood, community, and Harlem’s past and present.

Name: Cafe One
Description: It’s a cozy cafe yet very small , an it’s mostly a grab and go spot but they have many variety in foods and beverages

Name: Mon Amour Inwood
Description: Cozy cafe but tons of sunlight, simplistic yet woodsy inviting environment next to a park. Decent drinks. Not many outlets mostly across from the booth maybe 2-3 at most. Bathroom in back. Wifi confirmed at WPA3 Personal.

Name: El Barrista Cafe
Description: Cozy but welcoming cafe to get work done, more seating towards the back

Name: Ginjan Cafe
Description: Ginjan Cafe is a vibrant community-centric space celebrated for its African-inspired specialty drinks, most notably its signature ginger beverages. The warm, earthy decor and energetic vibe create an immediately welcoming environment for anyone looking to work or socialize. It stands out as a culturally rich hub with delicious, health-conscious menu options.

Name: Common Good Harlem
Address: 2801 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10039
Description: Common Good Harlem is a community-focused neighborhood anchor designed to bring people together over exceptional coffee and food. The spacious interior boasts a welcoming layout with plenty of room to work, collaborate, or simply enjoy a quiet moment. Its strong community spirit and comfortable ambiance make it an essential uptown workspace.

Name: Beanstalk Cafe
Address: 13-33 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101
Description: Beanstalk Cafe is a charming neighborhood nook that offers a cozy, leafy retreat from the busy city streets. The intimate interior provides a quiet atmosphere where remote workers can focus easily without excessive distractions. It's a delightful, understated spot for quality coffee and productivity.

Name: Stepping Stone Cafe
Address: 2-20 Malt Dr, Long Island City, NY 11101
Description: Stepping Stone Cafe acts as the perfect launching pad for your workday, offering a friendly and unpretentious environment. The cozy layout features dependable seating and a welcoming neighborhood crowd that makes it easy to settle in. Enjoy a solid cup of coffee and a pastry while knocking out your to-do list.

Name: The Local Bar & Cafe
Description: A great hangout cafe/bar to get work done and/or socialize, closes for the night for hotel members only later in the evening.

Name: Olive Coffee
Description: Gold Coffee is a sleek and inviting neighborhood spot that delivers high-quality brews in a polished setting. It features a clean, minimalist aesthetic with comfortable seating areas tailored for focused laptop sessions. Friendly baristas and a steady stream of delicious espresso drinks make it a reliable daytime workspace.

Name: Full Moon Cafe
Description: Full Moon Cafe is a cozy neighborhood spot that charms locals with its unpretentious atmosphere and friendly service. The relaxed environment offers a comfortable backdrop for tackling daily tasks without the rush of corporate coffee chains. Patrons can enjoy reliable brews and classic cafe bites in a laid-back setting.

Name: Busy Bee Coffee
Description: Busy Bee Coffee lives up to its name by offering an energetic, bustling environment that keeps productivity flowing. The cheerful interior is well-suited for fast-paced remote work sessions or quick morning pit stops. With a menu full of revitalizing espresso drinks and quick bites, it keeps momentum high.

Name: Florist Bar Co
Description: Florist Bar Co. is one of the most unique cafes to have scouted, hidden away in flushing with a projector screen often showing animal crossing or fun displays, tons of comfortable seats and outlets spread out throughout the cafe, not too much walking space but tons of seats, beautiful flowers and fun drinks. Only downside is WiFi has a limit of 2 hours with each purchase to help upkeep their business tucked away here in Flushing but is an easy fix.

Name: Good Days Cafe
Description: Good Days Cafe radiates positivity with its bright decor, uplifting playlist, and welcoming neighborhood energy. The thoughtfully curated interior features comfortable corners that invite guests to settle in for a productive afternoon. It's a delightful spot designed to turn any routine workday around.

Name: Finjan Cafe
Description: Outlets tons of seating has outlets and restroom and wifi

Name: Foreigner NYC
Description: More of a stop-and-go cafe, great for getting some light work done on your laptop and decent drinks (A bit more on the pricey side)

Name: Ten Thousand Coffee
Description: Chill and minimal cafe, great spot for meetings when not overcrowded, fun drinks and desserts. Clean restroom, great service and inviting atmosphere

Name: Pueblo Querido Coffee Roasters Café de Colombia
Address: 29-47 Northern Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11101
Description: Good amount of open floor, a bit hidden to find at first. Columbian based small business, beautiful artwork with windows overlooking the subway. Must ask for wifi as there are multiple but tons of seating, note visible ventailiators and air conditioning above on ceiling

Name: Chateau le Woof
Description: Dog centered and dog friendly cafe with up to 2 additional spaces including a space with an enclosed playpen to bring your dog to socialize and work on your laptop all in the same area, additionally with treats, accessories, and fun items for sale based on NYC dogs. Tons of space and seating especially for dogs, they have over 30 flavors to choose from for your drink too! Only downside is outlets are a bit scattered so ccome with a fully charged laptop and bathroom can be hard to spot at first, ask staff for help - super friendly.

Name: Zaruma Gold Coffee
Description: Zaruma Gold Coffee delivers authentic Ecuadorian flavor straight to the neighborhood with its premium-sourced coffee beans and rich heritage. The welcoming space features a clean, comfortable layout that accommodates both remote workers and casual visitors. It's a hidden gem for discovering exceptional brews in a relaxed setting.
